caption: Castello di Santa Severa, Santa Severa
composition: Coastal medieval fortress with cylindrical towers beside a Tyrrhenian beach · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: From the beach, the camera looks along the shore to the Castello di Santa Severa rising on its rocky promontory at the center-left in the bright 11:48 midday sun. Cylindrical towers and crenellated walls of honey-colored stone crown the rocks, the village rooftops cluster at the lower left, and the sandy beach curves at the bottom edge where turquoise water laps the shore. The wooded coastline stretches away to the right under a clear blue sky.
